key_idea: Turning a hand around does not change it, but flipping it like a mirror changes right to left.
steps: Each hand has a thumb sticking out on one side.
Sort the hands into two groups. 3 hands match the top left hand, even when turned upside down. The other 5 are its mirror image, with the thumb on the other side.
Hold up your right hand and decide which group it matches. These hands do not show if we see the palm or the back, so look carefully.
Count the hands in the group that matches your right hand.

choice_feedback.A: The hands come in two groups, 3 and 5, so the count cannot be 2.
choice_feedback.C: The hands come in two groups, 3 and 5, so the count cannot be 4.
choice_feedback.D: 5 is the size of one group. Decide which group shows right hands.
choice_feedback.E: The hands come in two groups, 3 and 5, so the count cannot be 6.
